title: The Vocabulary That Doubles Your Conversion Rate
caption: Words change how people feel about buying. These 7 swaps work everywhere. Comment 'SYS' and follow for the full list.
tips: Reply to EVERY comment in the first hour - it doubles the algorithm push.
Post 4-5 times a week consistently for 4 weeks before judging anything.
Post at evening local time (19:00-21:00) for max initial engagement.
thumbnail: Split screen: red X words vs green check words, big bold '7 WORDS' in the middle.
script:
[HOOK] 5 words to never say in productivity.
[PAIRS - rapid fire]
Don't say hustle, instead say system - because people hustle burns out, systems compound.
Don't say work harder, instead say work smarter - effort isn't the edge.
Don't say more hours, instead say better blocks - hours don't scale, focus does.
Don't say multitask, instead say batch - batching actually finishes.
Don't say stay busy, instead say stay focused - busy is a trap.
[CLOSE] Your productivity does not have to sound like everyone else's. Comment 'SYS' and I will send you the full list.
Make sure you follow - it only goes to followers.
